name: zz-access
description: Access, yours and everybody's: your platform token, your keys for the building blocks, and the setup for whichever client you work in — plus, if your role carries them, the people, teams, flow installs and block grants behind them. One door; the tools you are offered are the ones your role can execute.
purpose: To be the one door for every question about who may do what — your platform token, your client setup, and, if your role carries them, the people, teams and installs behind them. A tool belongs here when it hands somebody a credential, changes who holds one, or changes what a team may install. Answering for the deployment itself is NOT here: an operator act belongs on the door that owns its subject, which is why the bug tools and the index rebuild sit with the records they are about.
